claim: Intel's fiscal year 2024 filing showed -$19B in net income, plus $53.1 billion in revenue.
summary: Based on prior knowledge, Intel's FY2024 (10-K filed early 2025) reported revenue of ~$53.101B (~$53.1B rounded) and a GAAP net loss attributable to Intel of ~$19.2-19.23B (~-$19B rounded), matching both atomic assertions.

sub_claims.text: Intel's fiscal year 2024 filing showed net income of approximately -$19 billion
sub_claims.note: Prior knowledge: Intel FY2024 GAAP net loss ~$19.2-19.3B, which rounds to -$19B

sub_claims.text: Intel's fiscal year 2024 filing showed revenue of approximately $53.1 billion
sub_claims.note: Prior knowledge: Intel FY2024 revenue ~$53.101B, reported as $53.1B
